assert: (() => { const s = window.__homesim.getState(); return s.life.current.result.careRate === 1 && s.home.plants.every((p) => p.alive !== false) && s.home.animals.every((a) => a.present !== false); })()
(() => { const h = window.__life.view().home; return h.plants.every((p) => p.object.userData.healthy) && h.animals.every((a) => a.object.visible); })()

eval: (() => { const v = window.__life.view(), sc = v.scene, t = sc.controls.target, p = sc.camera.position; p.set(2 * t.x - p.x, p.y, 2 * t.z - p.z); sc.controls.update(); sc.requestRender(); return true; })()
